name: Golden Ally Lifetech Group, Inc.
summary: Golden Ally Lifetech Group, Inc., a company in its developmental stage, concentrates on innovating across advanced technologies, energy solutions, and medical equipment. Within the bioscience and sports medicine fields, it is actively developing items like Sterilal self-sanitizing devices, PASS smart denture mouth guards, portable heart attack detection units, and melanoma screening systems. Additionally, the company provides the InCharge magnetic battery device for energy, and is making progress on graphene-based de-icing applications for the aviation industry. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, the firm was formerly known as Signet International Holdings, Inc. until it rebranded in July 2022.
